title: Cornell’s President Grilled by Faculty Senate Over Handling of Crisis
summary: Ahead of a vote on a resolution of no confidence in Michael I. Kotlikoff, some faculty members said they were not swayed by steps he announced on Tuesday, including banning fraternity parties.
